# RBF Construction, Inc.

> RBF Construction, Inc. ("A Rather Be Fishing Company") is a general contractor headquartered in Flint, Michigan that serves all of Oakland County and Southeast Michigan. It does kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom homes and additions, commercial construction (office buildings, restaurants, medical and dental offices, retail), construction management and design-build, and complete site work: excavation, grading, underground utilities, parking lots, concrete and demolition.

## Key facts
- Legal name: RBF Construction, Inc.
- Also known as: RBF Construction, RBF
- Tagline: "A Rather Be Fishing Company"
- Business type: General contractor (residential and commercial); site development contractor
- Headquarters: 1411 W Hill Rd, Flint, MI 48507, USA
- Phone: 810-938-8498
- Email: info@rbfconstruction.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Service area: all of Oakland County and Southeast Michigan, including Oakland County, Genesee County, Livingston County, Macomb County, Wayne County, Lapeer County, Washtenaw County counties
- Brands built for: Jimmy John's, Pizza Hut, Smoothie King, Taco Bell, Dollar Tree, Biggby Coffee, Cottage Inn Pizza, Athletico Physical Therapy
- Facebook: https://facebook.com/rbfconstructioninc/

## Service categories
- [General Contracting](https://rbfconstruction.com/general-contracting): construction management, design-build, design-bid-build, consulting

- [Commercial](https://rbfconstruction.com/commercial-general-contracting): offices, restaurants, medical, retail, tenant build-outs

## Services
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://rbfconstruction.com/kitchen-remodeling): Kitchen remodeling contractor for Oakland County and Southeast Michigan: layout changes, cabinets, countertops, tile, lighting and permits handled.
- [Bathroom Remodeling](https://rbfconstruction.com/bathroom-remodeling): Bathroom remodeling in Oakland County and Southeast Michigan: walk-in showers, tub conversions, tile, vanities and accessible, aging-in-place baths.
- [Custom Homes & Additions](https://rbfconstruction.com/custom-home-builder): Ground-up custom homes and additions in Oakland County and Southeast Michigan, with in-house excavation, foundations, driveways and utilities.
- [Office Buildings](https://rbfconstruction.com/office-building-construction): Office building construction, tenant build-outs and office renovations in Oakland County and Southeast Michigan. Design-build or design-bid-build.
- [Restaurants](https://rbfconstruction.com/restaurant-construction): Restaurant and drive-thru construction in Michigan for national brands and local owners: ground-up builds, remodels, build-outs and site work.
- [Medical & Dental](https://rbfconstruction.com/medical-office-construction): Medical office, dental, physical therapy and clinic construction in Oakland County and Southeast Michigan. New buildings and build-outs.
- [Retail & Businesses](https://rbfconstruction.com/retail-construction): Retail, strip center and commercial business construction in Southeast Michigan: ground-up buildings, renovations, facades and build-outs.
- [Excavation & Grading](https://rbfconstruction.com/excavation-grading): Commercial and residential excavation, mass grading, land balancing and site clearing in Oakland County, Genesee County and Southeast Michigan.
- [Underground Utilities](https://rbfconstruction.com/underground-utilities): Storm sewer, sanitary sewer, water main, retention pond and pump station installation in Oakland County, Genesee County and Southeast Michigan.
- [Parking Lots, Roads & Concrete](https://rbfconstruction.com/parking-lot-paving-concrete): Parking lots, private roads, drive-thru lanes, concrete curbs, gutters, sidewalks and slabs for commercial and residential sites in Southeast Michigan.
- [Demolition](https://rbfconstruction.com/demolition): Commercial and residential demolition, interior selective demolition, pavement removal and site clearing in Southeast Michigan.

## Guides
- [Design-Build vs. Design-Bid-Build: Which Is Right for Your Project?](https://rbfconstruction.com/resources/design-build-vs-design-bid-build): Design-build puts design and construction under one contract for speed and a single point of responsibility; design-bid-build separates them for maximum design control and competitive pricing.
- [Planning a Kitchen or Bathroom Remodel in Southeast Michigan](https://rbfconstruction.com/resources/kitchen-bathroom-remodel-planning-guide): Define scope first, set a budget with a contingency, make selections before demolition, confirm permits, and hire a contractor who manages trades and inspections.
- [What Site Work Does a Commercial Building Need?](https://rbfconstruction.com/resources/commercial-site-work-guide): Commercial site work includes clearing and demolition, earthwork and grading, underground utilities, storm water management, paving, concrete and final grading — often a large share of total project cost.

## FAQ
### What does RBF Construction do?
RBF Construction, Inc. is a full-service general contractor serving Oakland County, Genesee County and Southeast Michigan. We do kitchen and bathroom remodeling, custom homes and additions, commercial construction of office buildings, restaurants, medical and dental offices and retail, plus complete site work: excavation, grading, underground utilities, parking lots, concrete and demolition.

### What areas do you serve?
We serve all of Oakland County and Southeast Michigan, including Genesee, Livingston, Macomb, Wayne, Lapeer and Washtenaw counties. See all service areas.

### Where is RBF Construction located?
Our office is at 1411 W Hill Rd, Flint, MI 48507, just off I-75 north of Oakland County. We’re open Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Call 810-938-8498 or email info@rbfconstruction.com.

### Do you do kitchen and bathroom remodels?
Yes. We remodel kitchens and bathrooms throughout Oakland County and Southeast Michigan, from cabinet and countertop updates to full remodels with layout changes, walk-in showers and accessible, aging-in-place bathrooms. We handle the trades, permits and inspections.

### What types of commercial buildings do you build?
Office buildings and tenant build-outs, restaurants including drive-thrus, medical, dental and physical therapy offices, retail stores and multi-tenant buildings. We’ve built for brands such as Jimmy John’s, Pizza Hut, Smoothie King, Taco Bell, Dollar Tree, Biggby Coffee, Cottage Inn Pizza and Athletico Physical Therapy.

### Can RBF take a project from raw land to a finished building?
Yes. Our in-house site development division handles demolition, excavation, grading, utilities, paving and concrete, and we build the building too — one contractor from groundbreaking to completion.

### What’s the difference between design-build and design-bid-build?
In design-build, one team handles design and construction under a single contract, which simplifies communication and can shorten schedules. In design-bid-build, an architect completes the design first and contractors bid on it. RBF does both. Read our design-build vs. design-bid-build guide.

### How do I get a bid or estimate?
Call 810-938-8498 or send project details through our bid request form. Plans, photos, the site address and your target timeline help us respond faster.

### I’m a subcontractor. How do I get on your bid list?
Submit your company information on our subcontractor bidding list page and we’ll reach out when projects in your trade and area come up for bid.
